_source.2e: For Gold & Glory (free 2e retroclone) — decided 2e RAW, MECHANUS.md §10
_source.method: 80 (Hit Dice, THACO) pairs harvested from bestiary pp.309-384, 2026-06-05; brackets fit canonical 2e monster table with plus-bump
_source.warrior_table: FG&G p.27 Table 3.3 (THACO 21-level) — monsters advance on the bracket table below
_source.creature_table: FG&G p.310 Table C.3 (Creature THACO) — brackets <=16 HD match row-for-row; p.309 prints the +3-hp bump (one Hit Die greater); p.310 carve-out: humans/demi-humans always use PC THACO values (bestiary demi-human entries print 1 HD -> 20)
_source.note_17plus: [17,99]->3 extends past Table C.3 (which ends '16+: 5') via the warrior table (p.27, L18 -> 3); in-range specimens deviate (titan 20->5, tarrasque 70->-5, both recorded below). Meme ratified keep-3, 2026-06-06 (correction docket ask d).

plus_bump.rule: HD bonus of +3 or more counts as one Hit Die greater (may cross into the next bracket) — FG&G p.309, 'treated as a creature of one hit die greater... for purposes of THACO and saving throws'
plus_bump.evidence: 6+3→13, 8+8→11, 4+3→15, 7+3→13 all observed (7+3→13 proves next-die, not next-bracket)

_evidence.fit_after_fraction_fix: ~84% (68/81 single-value stat pairs, full pp.309-384 census 2026-06-06; demi-human entries excluded — printed PC-THACO carve-out p.310)
_evidence.note: harvest regex initially swallowed '1/2' as '1'; fractional-HD monsters are the <1 bracket (20). severity: soft — 2e prints deviate by author intent.
